math_notes: All game arithmetic uses integer numerators sharing the current station denominator. place/undo and equality checks do not compare floating-point fractions.

The shown whole 1 is explicitly the 0-to-1 ruler segment; unit=800/domain and all rail endpoints use numerator/denominator times the same unit. Whole size stays consistent within each station, including improper and mixed fractions.

Actual UI displays station base, signed selected pieces and destination length. sampleProblems uses generateStation too and asks for the required added/removed difference, matching actual construction semantics.
Independently checked pictured terminal ticket: 2 1/4 minus 1 2/4 equals 3/4, correct. First station starts1/4, target3/4, so adding2/4 is correct.
Read 6000-sample verification with zero math failures and 244 unique prompts. The finite generator is adequate for twelve stations but should not be described as 6000 distinct puzzles.
strengths: Fraction addition/removal directly changes the rail length; equal subdivisions and an explicit whole1 provide a better conceptual representation than detached answer choices.
Twelve-station real-input evidence records 53 clicks, scenic station choices and completion after an initial mistake, with zero browser errors.
Undo restores stock, numerator and available move budget exactly; an ordinary mistake does not remove the route to completion.
Generated title is attractive and locally hosted. Mobile fractions and three piece buttons are legible; wide scene expands across the viewport.
No countdown pressures fraction reasoning. Completion ticket presents the actual aggregate equation.

limitations.detail: depart on an incorrect length only increments mistakes/totalErrors and reduces the eventual station-star award. Undo remains unlimited; the puzzle is intentionally an unlimited-retry learning expedition. getState lives:3 is a constant compatibility field, not three expendable chances. Do not report a tested three-life loss branch or conventional survival game.

At station12 the visible screen correctly says completed and solved=12; internal phase remains arrival, not won. Host end-to-end assertions should test solved12 plus terminal heading rather than claim phasewon evidence.

The three-region trip repeats add/remove planning plus a short automatic train journey. Scenic routes and fewest-piece bonuses provide optimization, but there is no traversal challenge, economy, meaningful route network or action risk.

limitations.item: Onboarding is prose in a modal
limitations.detail: The three pages describe ruler/pieces/depart clearly but the code does not highlight the corresponding actual control. A visible spotlight would make first use more direct.

The title background is richly textured while most active train/rail/island shapes are flat Canvas. The new whole1 ruler is readable but small on mobile, and scene polish remains below the user's commercial-console aspiration.

evidence.scope: Read-only code/evidence/visual review as instructed while host serialized browsers. Reviewer did not launch a separate browser, rerun QA, or perform full catalogue screenshot comparison. Host will supplement final QA.

verdict: 완성된 분수 조작 퍼즐이며 발견된 수학 오류나 회복 불능 경로는 없다. 품질 점수79는 제한된 전략성과 미술 일관성을 반영하며, 사용자의80점미만 게시 허용으로 점수를 올리지 않고 배포할 수 있다. 무제한 다시 풀기 모델을 분명히 설명해야 한다.
